results.message: Who won the Booker Prize in each of the last three years, and which of those three books is the shortest?
results.answer:
The Booker Prize winners were David Szalay for *Flesh* (2025), Samantha Harvey for *Orbital* (2024), and Paul Lynch for *Prophet Song* (2023). ([thebookerprizes.com](https://thebookerprizes.com/media-centre/press-releases/flesh-by-david-szalay-wins-the-booker-prize-2025))

The shortest was *Orbital*, at 136 pages. The Booker Prize Foundation calls it the second-shortest book ever to win; its source does not give page counts for the other two novels here. ([thebookerprizes.com](https://thebookerprizes.com/the-booker-library/prize-years/2024))
